news.headline: Stifel and Lake Street cut price targets after ClearPoint Neuro's Q2 miss
news.summary: Following the Q2 revenue miss and guidance cut, Stifel lowered its price target to $22 from $25 and Lake Street lowered its target to $25 from $30, both while maintaining bullish ratings. Analysts still see the long-term biologics/drug-delivery ecosystem thesis intact despite near-term execution issues.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue miss, cuts full-year guidance, shares plunge
news.summary: Q2 revenue came in at $10.9 million (up 18% year-over-year) but about $1.8 million below consensus, with adjusted EPS loss of $0.38 versus an expected $0.29 loss; the company cut its 2026 revenue guidance to $48-$52 million from $52-$56 million. Shares fell roughly 15-20% in after-hours trading as cash dropped to $29.4 million from $45.9 million at the start of the year.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro unveils $500 million long-term revenue target and five-pillar growth strategy
news.summary: Alongside its Q2 results, management presented a five-pillar strategy targeting $500 million in annual revenue built around cell and gene therapy delivery to the brain, citing over $200 million invested and more than 60 active biopharma partners. Several partner programs are reportedly now under FDA expedited review pathways.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro signs 10-year focused ultrasound partnership with Sungkyunkwan University's SONOCARE Lab
news.summary: ClearPoint entered a 10-year focused ultrasound drug-delivery development partnership with the SONOCARE Lab at Sungkyunkwan University in South Korea, expanding its drug-delivery ecosystem and global footprint. The deal is supported by preclinical proof-of-concept data showing successful tracer delivery across the blood-brain barrier using ClearPoint's prototype system.

news.headline: ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) facility now operational, positioned to lift Biologics & Drug Delivery segment
news.summary: Management said the newly acquired CAL preclinical services facility is now in ClearPoint's possession and can support over $60 million in annual capacity, up from about $8 million previously. New CAL services revenue is expected to help return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to growth starting in Q3 2026.

news.headline: MAK Capital and BlackRock disclose sizable passive stakes in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund, MAK Capital One, and Michael A. Kaufman reported a 7.8% passive stake (2,375,861 shares) as of late July 2026, while BlackRock separately disclosed a 7.1% stake. The filings show continued institutional interest in the stock despite the post-earnings selloff.

catalysts.label: uniQure BLA submission for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application for AMT-130, a gene therapy delivered into the brain using ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow cannula, after the FDA agreed its 3-year Phase I/II data can support an accelerated-approval filing. A BLA submission and eventual approval would be a major validation and future revenue driver for ClearPoint's delivery platform.

catalysts.label: Biologics & Drug Delivery segment return to growth
catalysts.detail: Management guided that new CAL (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) preclinical services revenue should return the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment to sequential growth beginning in Q3 2026, reversing the 15% year-over-year decline seen in Q2.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro's next quarterly report will show whether the company is tracking toward its cut $48-52 million full-year 2026 revenue guidance and whether the CAL facility ramp and IRRAflow integration are delivering the expected growth.

catalysts.label: Robotic platform and Harmony 1.0 software development
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint is developing an in-house robotic delivery platform and Harmony 1.0 software meant to unify control of its drug-delivery ecosystem; the company gathered feedback from more than 50 neurosurgeons in Q2 2026, with commercial availability still pending.

catalysts.label: Focused ultrasound program milestones (Sungkyunkwan/SONOCARE partnership)
catalysts.detail: The newly signed 10-year focused ultrasound development partnership is expected to generate preclinical and early development milestones as ClearPoint expands beyond catheter-based delivery into non-invasive blood-brain-barrier opening technology.

catalysts.label: Additional biopharma partner regulatory milestones
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint has cited more than 60 active biopharma partners using its delivery platform, with several programs reportedly under FDA expedited review; further partner-specific trial, filing, or approval news (beyond uniQure) could serve as incremental catalysts through the rest of 2026.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro's Q2 2026 results missed expectations and the company cut full-year revenue guidance to $48-52 million, sending shares down sharply and prompting price-target cuts from Stifel and Lake Street, even as cash reserves thinned to $29.4 million. Despite the near-term stumble, the company doubled down on its long-term thesis, unveiling a $500 million revenue ambition, a new 10-year focused ultrasound partnership in South Korea, and an expanded CAL preclinical facility, while partner uniQure's FDA-agreed path toward a Huntington's disease gene-therapy BLA (delivered via ClearPoint's platform) remains the most closely watched external catalyst. The stock remains volatile and sentiment-sensitive, balancing execution risk and cash burn against a broadening biopharma partner base and expanding drug-delivery ecosystem.
